segments.title: May
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! May is Home for the Holidays. Students are back, mums are celebrated, and the studio has afternoons that are suspiciously quiet. This month we fill those quiet hours, and keep April's party guests from turning into ghosts.

segments.title: ₹1.55L
segments.text: So, the number. Our May target for Pop-up is 1.55 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last May. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 85,000 rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 68,000, and everything else 1,500. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 41 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 481 leads, 125 trials, and 41 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 67,700 rupees, which is 44 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Mom Said Get Off the Couch
segments.text: First up, Mom Said Get Off the Couch. Students get eight classes at twenty per cent off, in the off-peak hours when the studio is practically theirs. Mum will be thrilled. The plan is 3 buyers at about 5,500, so 16,600 rupees.

segments.title: Mom-entum
segments.text: Next, for Mother's Day, Mom-entum. Mother and child duos get a duo private and a gift for mum, and newcomers get fifteen per cent off their first month. She carried you for nine months. You can carry her to class. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.

segments.title: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight)
segments.text: Then, Group Project, where finally, everyone pulls their weight. Squads of four students buying together each get twenty-five per cent off, off-peak only. Free-loaders still have to do the planks. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,200, so 10,400 rupees.

segments.title: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
segments.text: And finally, for April's new friends, Don't Ghost Us After the Party. Show up eight times this month, and your next renewal costs less, plus a private on us. Great party. Now the real test. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,200, so 28,900 rupees.
segments.notes: ≈20% effective on 3M, ≈20% on 1M with the private

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, student offers go live in the quiet afternoon hours. Week two, Mother's Day duos, gifts wrapped, tissues on standby. Week three, every April joiner is tracked towards eight classes. Week four, squads of four close their group buys.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's May at Pop-up. 1.55 lakh rupees, four offers, and 41 buyers to welcome. Quiet hours, filled. Party guests, kept. That's a good May.
